cases.name: transition_to_failed_carries_error
cases.note: a failure records both the message and the code; a native writer that drops the code leaves an owner-facing surface with nothing to present

cases.name: progress_bump
cases.note: the received/total pair the owner's install progress reads from. ⚠ It takes no journal — it composes a new status and the CALLER persists it, which is a different ownership from every other verb here

cases.name: progress_bump_without_total
cases.note: a server that sends no content length; total stays absent rather than becoming zero, which would render as 100%

cases.name: stale_attempt_write_is_refused
cases.note: 🔴 the lost-update guard: a status captured before another attempt began must not be able to write over it
cases.refused: InstallStatusConflictError: different attempt while install in-flight

cases.name: assert_current_after_replacement
cases.note: the same guard read rather than written

cases.name: record_interrupted
cases.note: what a killed installer leaves behind, which is the state the next start has to recognise

cases.name: record_interrupted_wrong_attempt
cases.note: an interruption reported against an attempt that is no longer the current one must not clobber the live attempt
cases.refused: InstallStatusConflictError: interrupted attempt id does not match

cases.name: malformed_record_is_refused_not_replaced
cases.note: 🔴 fail closed on read: a status that exists and will not parse raises rather than being silently reset to idle, which would lose the evidence of what went wrong

cases.name: unknown_provider_is_refused
cases.note: the provider vocabulary is closed; a path is never built from an unvalidated name
cases.refused: ValueError: provider install status must be one of: ['local', 'parakeet']
